_note: Alexa interaction-model additions for the screens (routes/alexa.py). Phrased to follow the skill's own pattern, "computer, use AI to ...". No config in the model: the day is free text, read on the server (today, yesterday, last Tuesday...). review_day replays a screen's pictures for that day, with the transitions between them (owner, 24 Nov). Merge into languageModel.intents (Alexa console > Build > Interaction Model > JSON Editor), then Save Model and Build Model.
